==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am inside a videogame. There is a mad scientist who presents me with the game's wiki on his laptop. The game seems to be dynamically generated based on wiki entries.

Mutant rhinos with glowing red eyes appear. They crash through a wall and race towards me. I am crushed by their stampede.

I revive and discover a secret level. The secret level involves the mad scientist inviting me onto their rocketship. I don't know why we're going into space, but it might be to dodge the rhinos.
